notes: Cuts no longer stop short. Every cut was turning the arc off exactly ON the end of the cut, and a cut ending on another cut was trimmed to the edge wire rather than to the neighbouring toolpath half a kerf further on - together that left about a millimetre of metal holding at the end of every cut. Cuts now reach the neighbouring toolpath and stay lit past it by a settable overburn. Stitch cutting is now an extension of common cutting: both act on the seam between a part and the one in front, and Stitch is greyed out unless Common cut is on. The final sever is never stitched. Auto-apply of end conditions is OFF - the geometry is still measured and shown, but nothing is written automatically. Also: the ghost rides the datum with ripped parts, a common cut can be closed again after being opened, and large holes no longer burn past closure.
